learning_objective: 🎯 Peek behind the scenes of a hotel to learn how the hospitality industry works, from greeting guests at the front desk to ensuring their rooms are spotless!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Hospitality is the friendly and generous reception and entertainment of guests, visitors, or strangers. The industry includes hotels, restaurants, resorts, and tourism services.
Often called the 'nerve center' or 'hub' of a hotel. It is the first point of contact for guests. They handle reservations, check-in/check-out, room assignments, and billing.
Responsible for the cleanliness, maintenance, and aesthetic upkeep of rooms and public areas. A hotel's reputation heavily depends on the quality of its housekeeping.
This department handles the kitchen (food production) and the restaurants/room service (food service). It is a major revenue generator for hotels.
The experience of a guest involves 4 stages: Pre-arrival (booking), Arrival (check-in), Occupancy (staying and using services), and Departure (billing and check-out).

fun_activity.title: 🛎️ The Front Desk Roleplay
fun_activity.instructions: Pretend your home is a 5-star hotel. Write a 3-line script on how you would greet a 'guest' (your sibling or parent) at the front door, ask for their reservation, and offer them a welcome drink!

exam_tips: 📌 Always refer to the Front Office as the 'nerve center' or 'face' of the hotel.
📌 Understand that Housekeeping works closely with the Front Office so the front desk knows which rooms are clean and ready to be sold.
📌 Be able to list the 4 stages of the 'Guest Cycle'.
quick_recap: ⭐ The hospitality industry sells an 'experience', not just a bed to sleep in.
⭐ The Concierge assists guests with specialized tasks like booking theater tickets or finding local attractions.
⭐ Good coordination between all departments is crucial for guest satisfaction.
